title: The Frozen Greenhouse
premise_public: A gardener found frost covering plants inside a locked greenhouse. Its heater had run normally all night.
solution_summary: Automatic roof vents opened because a temperature sensor near the heater falsely read excess warmth. Freezing air entered faster than the heater could warm the greenhouse.

facts.text: The greenhouse had automatically opening roof vents.
A temperature sensor was close to the heater.
The sensor falsely indicated the room was hot.
Freezing outside air entered through the openings.

acceptable_solutions: Automatic vents opened due to a sensor near the heater and let freezing air in.
A badly placed temperature sensor opened the roof vents while the heater still worked.
Cold air entered through automatic openings because the sensor read the heater's heat.
hints: Working heating cannot help much if warm air keeps escaping.
The locked door was not the only way air could enter.
